cache_rules.name: palvelut-bypass-sensitive-or-stateful
cache_rules.expression: starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/palvelut/") and (http.request.method not in {"GET" "HEAD"} or len(http.request.headers["cookie"][0]) gt 0 or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/palvelut/account/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/palvelut/staff/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/palvelut/report/") or http.request.uri.path in {"/palvelut/health/live" "/palvelut/health/ready"})

cache_rules.name: palvelut-anonymous-public-respect-origin
cache_rules.expression: http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/palvelut/") and len(http.request.headers["cookie"][0]) eq 0 and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/palvelut/account/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/palvelut/staff/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/palvelut/report/") and http.request.uri.path not in {"/palvelut/health/live" "/palvelut/health/ready"}

rate_limits.name: palvelut-content-report
rate_limits.expression: http.request.method eq "POST" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/palvelut/") and contains(http.request.uri.path, "/report/")
